correctness.rationale: The proof directly reconstructs the definition. Convexity of the complement rules out selecting a spine endpoint because its neighborhood is an independent set of size r+1; it then forces any selected internal page vertex to bring its page mate. General position forbids two complete selected pages via a geodesic a_i-b_i-y-b_j. Conversely, one internal page pair is valid because any outside-to-outside path that enters the selected page uses a three-edge x-y segment and is shortened by the spine edge. The independent checker enumerates all subsets for r=2..9 and exactly matches the theorem.
